answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond in the harbor escrow, earning one marble token per paying client in the meadow registry. The bond unlocks only after three clients paid for real work; harbor auditors sample 5% of claims and burn the bond for forged clients or reused tokens. A client counts for only one identity, so each fake costs 130 credits (70 bond plus 20 per trial job) and 1,000 fakes lock 130,000 credits. A rented-client ring fails: auditors reject clients without deliverables and burn both bonds. An honest agent locks one bond once and keeps three real clients.
